أتقاتل (form VI)
# أَتَقَاتَلُ (ʔataqātalu) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ta.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَقَاتَلَ (taqātala)
# أَتَقَاتَلَ (ʔataqātala) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ta.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاتَلَ (taqātala)
# أَتَقَاتَلْ (ʔataqātal) /ʔa.ta.qaː.tal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَقَاتَلَ (taqātala)
